import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
print(w.work_id.nunique(), w.year.isna().sum())
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w=w.dropna(subset=['year']); w['late']=w.year>=1876; w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages
print(w.groupby(['genre','late']).r.agg(['mean','size']).unstack())
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack(); return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()
print(est(w))
for dc in ['high','medium','low']: print(dc,est(w[w.date_confidence==dc]))
print('noother',est(w[~w.genre.isin(['other','collection'])]))
print('origin',[ (o,est(w[w.origin==o])) for o in ['UK','US','unknown']])
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
gr={k:v for k,v in w.groupby(['genre','late'])}
for i in range(2000):
  s=pd.concat([v.sample(len(v),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for v in gr.values()]); bs.append(est(s))
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
print(w.groupby('decade').r.mean())
print(w[(w[c]>0)&w.late&(w.date_confidence=='high')].sample(4,random_state=1).sample_passage_ids.tolist())
"
